services.title: Radiator repair

services.title: Recore and tanks
services.description: If the tanks and fittings are good, we recore instead of selling you a box-store radiator.

services.title: Cooling flush
services.description: Flush, fill, and test so a new recore isn't sitting in dirty coolant.

services.title: A/C service
services.description: Charge, leak check, and condenser work so the cabin actually gets cold.

services.title: Heater cores
services.description: No heat, fogged glass, or wet carpet — we find the core leak and replace it right.

services.title: Fleet cooling
services.description: Work vans and light trucks — scheduled recore and same-week turnaround when we can.

services.title: Diagnostics
services.description: Gauge up, fan inop, or a mystery overheat — we test before we quote a radiator.

faq.question: How long does a radiator recore take?
faq.answer: Most passenger recore jobs are same-day or next morning once the core is on the bench. Fleet work and hard-to-source tanks take longer. You'll get a time estimate before we start.

faq.question: Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are welcome. If every bay is full we'll still look at it and tell you when we can pull it in. Fleet drop-offs: call before 9:00 AM and we'll hold bay time.

faq.question: Repair, recore, or replace — how do you decide?
faq.answer: We pressure-test first. Small leaks and tank work usually repair. A soft or clogged core gets recored when the tanks are worth keeping. If the unit is finished we'll say so and price a replacement against the recore.

faq.question: Do you work on fleet vehicles and A/C too?
faq.answer: Yes. Passenger cars, work vans, and light trucks, plus A/C and heater cores. Bring the vehicle or just the radiator and we'll tell you which makes more sense.

faq.question: Is the work under warranty?
faq.answer: 12-month workmanship on recore and A/C jobs. Ask at pickup if you want it in writing.
